info.title: Clean Architecture API
info.description:
Generated from the Zod request schemas — do not edit by hand.

Every response uses one envelope: `{ status, data }` on success and `{ status, error: { code, message, issues? }, requestId }` on failure. Clients should branch on `error.code`, which is stable, never on `message`.

`/branches` exists only when BRANCHES_ENABLED=true; `/tenants` only when TENANCY_MODE=multi.
